sustainability.heading: our commitment to sustainability
sustainability.body: We buy directly from local farmers and producers, and as much as we can from within our regional foodshed. Keeping our purchasing close to home supports a more resilient local food economy. In the kitchen we work to waste as little as possible, using each ingredient fully: repurposing trim and preserving surplus.
